paper.title_en: Unifying energy-entropy bounds in semiclassical gravity
paper.abstract_en: We revisit bounds on energy and entropy in semiclassical gravity, aiming to strengthen and unify established bounds, in particular the quantum focussing conjecture (QFC) and the smeared null energy condition (SNEC). Both the QFC and SNEC have important applications and are the strongest in their respective hierarchies; however, neither implies the other, nor reduces to the null energy condition (NEC) in the classical limit. To that end, we define a new class of bounds dubbed gravitational energy-entropy conditions (GEECs) that imply both the QFC and SNEC, and reduce to the NEC classically. We construct an explicit family of GEECs by imposing the defining criteria on a broad set of stress tensor bounds, and constrain its remaining parameter space through test cases, in an effective field theory-inspired approach. Our GEECs are powerful candidate bounds on energy and entropy in semiclassical gravity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文聚焦半经典引力中的能量-熵界，提出新的一类引力能量-熵条件（GEECs），并论证其同时蕴含量子聚焦猜想（QFC）与涂抹零能条件（SNEC），且在经典极限下退化为零能条件（NEC）。主题属于引力的半经典/基础层面，理论深度较高，构造性与统一性目标清晰，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 半经典引力中能量-熵界的统一
decision.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视半经典引力中关于能量与熵的界，旨在加强并统一已有的若干界，特别是量子聚焦猜想（QFC）与涂抹零能条件（SNEC）。QFC 与 SNEC 都有重要应用，并且分别是各自层级中最强的；然而，二者互不蕴含，在经典极限下也都不化为零能条件（NEC）。为此，我们定义了一类新的界，称为引力能量-熵条件（GEECs），它同时蕴含 QFC 与 SNEC，并在经典情形下退化为 NEC。我们通过将定义性判据施加于一大类应力张量界，构造出一族显式的 GEECs，并以受有效场论启发的方法，通过若干测试情形约束其剩余的参数空间。我们的 GEECs 是半经典引力中能量与熵的有力候选界。
